methodology: Each prompt below was researched via live web search on 2026-09-09. Brands listed are ones actually named as recommendations in the cited source for that specific query -- not generated from memory or a template. Reddit itself could not be searched or fetched directly (r/headphones, r/audiophile etc. block automated access from this environment), so no entry cites a raw Reddit URL; where a secondary source claims to summarize Reddit discussion, that's noted and treated with lower confidence than a named review outlet (RTINGS, SoundGuys, What Hi-Fi, TechRadar, B&H are established, byline-driven publications; a few other sources returned by search read as low-effort SEO/content-mill sites and are flagged below). This is NOT a live-AI-engine test (no ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity/Alexa API access) -- it's real editorial/buying-guide consensus, which is a reasonable proxy for what those engines would likely surface (they're trained on and often cite this same kind of content) but not identical to it.
